== History ==
The date of foundation is unknown. In ancient times, it is said to have been enshrined in Miwa-go, {{ill|Kuboya district|ja|窪屋郡|zh|窪屋郡|qid=Q11597661}}, {{ill|Bitchū Province|cs|Provincie Biččú|de|Provinz Bitchū|es|Provincia de Bitchū|fa|ولایت بیچو|fi|Bitchūn provinssi|fr|Province de Bitchū|gl|Provincia de Bitchū|id|Provinsi Bitchū|it|Bitchū|ja|備中国|ko|빗추국|lt|Bičiū žemė|nl|Bitchu (provincie)|pt|Província de Bitchū|ru|Биттю (провинция)|simple|Bitchū Province|sk|Biččú|sr|Провинција Бичу|tr|Bitchū (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Біттю|zh|備中國|zh_min_nan|Bittyû-kok|qid=Q1047514}}, where it was revered as the chief guardian shrine of the area. It is also said that its former location was within what is now {{ill|Sōja|ar|سوجا (أوكاياما)|azb|سوجا، اوکایاما|ce|Содзя|ceb|Sōja|de|Sōja|el|Σότζα|es|Sōja (Okayama)|fa|سوجا، اوکایاما|fi|Sōja|fr|Sōja|gl|Sōja|ha|Sōja|id|Sōja, Okayama|it|Sōja|ja|総社市|ko|소자시|mg|Sōja|mzn|سوجا، اوکایاما|nl|Soja (Okayama)|pl|Sōja|pt|Soja (Okayama)|ro|Sōja|ru|Содзя|sv|Sōja, Okayama|tg|Соҷа|th|โซจะ|tl|Sōja|tr|Sōja|tt|Содзя|tum|Sōja|uk|Соджя|ur|سوجا|vi|Sōja, Okayama|war|Sōja, Okayama|zh|總社市|zh_classical|總社市|zh_min_nan|Sôzya-chhī|zh_yue|總社|qid=Q873536}}. Sugō Shrine is considered one of the leading candidate shrines (ronsha) for the Sugō Shrine listed as one of the 18 shrines in Bitchū Province recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|ar|إنجيشيكي (كتاب ياباني)|de|Engishiki|es|Engishiki|fr|Engishiki|he|אנגישיקי|id|Engishiki|it|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|ko|엔기시키|min|Engishiki|mr|इंगिशिकी|nl|Engishiki|pt|Engishiki|ru|Энгисики|simple|Engishiki|tr|Engishiki|uk|Енґісікі|zh|延喜式|qid=Q1342448|lt=Engi}} {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and one of the three within Kuboya District. There is also a record stating that in the 2nd year of {{ill|Gangyō|de|Gangyō|fa|گانکئو|fr|Ère Gangyō|ia|Gangyo|id|Genkei|ja|元慶|ko|간교|ru|Гэнгё|simple|Gangyō|sr|Гангјо|tr|Gangyō|uk|Ґанґьо|zh|元慶|zh_yue|元慶|qid=Q747451}} ({{ill|878|ab|878|af|878|als|878|am|878 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|878|ar|878|ary|878|ast|878|avk|878|az|878|azb|۸۷۸ (میلادی)|bcl|878|be|878|be_x_old|878|bg|878|bn|৮৭৮|bpy|মারি ৮৭৮|br|878|bs|878.|ca|878|cdo|878 nièng|ceb|878|ckb|٨٧٨|crh|878|cs|878|csb|878|cv|878|cy|878|da|878|de|878|el|878|eml|878|eo|878|es|878|et|878|eu|878|fa|۸۷۸ (میلادی)|fi|878|fo|878|fr|878|fy|878|ga|878|gan|878年|gd|878|gl|878|he|878|hi|878|hr|878.|ht|878 (almanak jilyen)|hu|878|hy|878|id|878|ilo|878|io|878|is|878|it|878|ja|878年|jv|878|ka|878|kaa|878|kk|878 жыл|ko|878년|la|878|lb|878|li|878|lij|878|lmo|878|lt|878 m.|lv|878. gads|map_bms|878|mdf|878|mg|878|mhr|878|mk|878|mr|इ.स. ८७८|mrj|878 и|ms|878|mzn|۸۷۸|nah|878|nap|878|nds|878|new|सन् ८७८|nl|878|nn|878|no|878|nrm|878|nso|878|oc|878|or|୮୭୮|os|878-æм аз|pl|878|pnb|878|pt|878|qu|878|ro|878|ru|878 год|rue|878|sa|८७८|sah|878|scn|878|sd|878ع|se|878|sh|878.|shn|878|si|878|sk|878|sl|878|smn|878|sq|878|sr|878|su|878|sv|878|sw|878|tg|Соли 878|th|พ.ศ. 1421|tk|878|tl|878|tly|878|tr|878|tt|878 ел|uk|878|ur|878ء|uz|878|vec|878|vi|878|war|878|wuu|878年|xmf|878|zh|878年|zh_min_nan|878 nî|zh_yue|878年|qid=Q23910}}), in {{ill|February (Lunisolar)|cdo|Nùng-lĭk 2 nguŏk|hak|Nùng-la̍k 2-ngie̍t|ja|2月 (旧暦)|ko|음력 2월|simple|Kisaragi|th|เดือนยี่|wuu|农历二月|za|Ndwenngeih|zh|农历二月|zh_min_nan|Kū-le̍k 2 goe̍h|zh_yue|二月|qid=Q838935|lt=February}}, the shrine—then ranked Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade in Bitchū Province—was granted promotion to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade. The parish area (ujiko) covers the Yuasu district of Kurashiki City, and the shrine is the origin of the place name Sugō Village (now the {{ill|Sugō|ja|菅生地区 (倉敷市)|qid=Q11619328|lt=Sugō}} district of Kurashiki City).

== Shrine grounds ==
There are no buildings other than the shrine structures. The main sanctuary consists of two main halls (Sugō Shrine and Himeōkami) connected together.
